entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes and some tires I recently purchased.
Okay, I can help you with that. Can I get your order number, please?
Thank you. I see the order here. Before we proceed, can you confirm whether the shoes or tires were ever mounted or installed on your bike?
Yes, I did try them out. The shoes have, you know, cleat marks because I mounted them to my pedals, and the tires were installed on my wheels for a short ride.

Thank you for that information. Unfortunately, because the shoes have cleat marks and the tires have been installed, indicating they have been used, we cannot accept them for return. Items must be in new, unused condition to be eligible for a refund.
Oh, really? Even though I only used them once?

Yes, I understand your frustration. However, once cycling shoes have been mounted and have cleat marks, and tires have been installed resulting in dirty tires, they are no longer considered new. Due to hygiene and safety reasons, and because we cannot resell used items as new, we are unable to process a return in this situation. Our return policy does state that mounted or installed items are non-refundable.
I see. That's disappointing, but I understand the policy. I should have read it more carefully.
I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. While a return isn't possible, I can offer you a discount code for your next purchase. It's 15% off any item on our website.
Really? That would be great, thank you!
You're welcome! The code is WELCOME15. It will be valid for the next 30 days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you so much for your help!
You're very welcome! Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
